title: Block the observation-only fusion storage variant
question: Does observing available buffer headroom guarantee later spill admission?
summary: A peer arriving after observation denies the candidate although the before-observation case completes.

workloads: 20k one-parent probe rows, 50/50/0 allocation and child shuffle; 32-MiB job/shared pool and a timed competing grant.

validation.summary: Typed Shared denials, owner lifetimes, exact successful output and cleanup pass; the denial is a scientific falsifier, not a harness failure.

limitations: This synthetic boundary does not measure performance or physical OOM.
exclusions: Earlier fitting and resident-wide successes cannot prove late-owner completion.
reopen_when: A separately reviewed real-owner remedy is required before a new admission claim.
